prosody_instruction: Speak softly, as if thinking aloud to oneself rather than addressing anyone. Slow pace, drifting cadence, occasional trailing-off at clause ends. Avoid directive intonation. The tone should feel introspective, distracted, almost wandering — like someone remembering, imagining, or recounting to themselves rather than asking a listener for help.

chunks.text: Last spring I was telling someone about that quick side trip I did in Xi'an—honestly I mostly just wandered around and took photos.
And later on, I remembered that work run where I went from Beijing down to Shanghai by rail—felt like the whole country was commuting that week.
Shanghai was the base for a bit too, so I ended up talking about hotels in Shanghai a lot with friends afterward.
In Xi'an, my cousin He Xia had handled the tickets for Huaqing Palace—there were 5 of us going together, so it was kind of a little family outing.
That Huaqing Palace visit was on 2025-03-11, and we specifically went in the afternoon because the morning was already packed.
For that Beijing–Shanghai stretch, my coworker Wang Fang had already gotten a ticket on D321 for 2025-04-25, and it was just Second Class—nothing fancy.
Oh, and in Shanghai, Xie Peng stayed at the Waldorf Astoria Shanghai on the Bund—checked in 2025-03-14 and stayed 2 nights, which sounded pretty perfect for the Bund area.
